text:
maria_sales: Heads-up — Onboarding Nova Systems for a 2-day POC. They asked for a hosted API key limited to a single workspace, IP allowlist (their office + CI), and a 48-hour TTL. They want zero manual intervention on their side during the demo.

kai_platform: Ok. Typical pattern: issue a short-lived hosted key with tags and network restrictions. But for zero intervention we recommend either SDK refresh or a short-lived proxy. Need to know traffic shape.

noah_se: They said they’ll run a heavy demo that hits 20 req/s for 3 hours. That should be fine with normal rate limits but might need temporary bump — we can monitor and switch to dedicated if it spikes.

maria_sales: They specifically worried about token rotation mid-run. If we rotate at T+24h it could break their CI.

frank_security: For POCs we allow proxying under strict conditions: must scope token to only inference endpoints, tag it as "poc_proxy:nova", add audit trail, and set strict expiry. Also require explicit consent in the SOW.

kai_platform: Proposed flow: 1) Create hosted key "nova-poc-48h" with expire_at (+172800s), tags: ["poc:nova","sales:maria"], network_restrictions set to office + CI CIDRs. 2) Send SDK refresher example to their engineers. 3) If they can't adopt it, spin up support proxy token that we rotate every 6h behind the scenes and forward.

maria_sales: They prefer no engineering work. Is the proxy an acceptable tradeoff?

frank_security: Yes but ops needs to record original caller and block admin endpoints. Also limit logs retention to 30d anonymized, per policy.

noah_se: Devex note: We have a tiny JS snippet that uses a refresh endpoint. I'll paste simplified version in the ticket: ```js
// pseudocode
async function getKey(){
  const r = await fetch('/internal/poc/refresh?nova');
  const {key, ttl} = await r.json();
  global.KEY = key;
}
setInterval(getKey, 5*60*1000); // refresh every 5m
```
Works for CI and demo apps.

kai_platform: I'll create the hosted key now with tags and expire_at. I'll also add an entry in the provisioning ticket to enable console-revoke for sales.

ops-bot: Ticket N-3917 created by kai_platform for nova-poc hosted key provisioning. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/N-3917

devex-bot: Attached SDK snippet and checklist to ticket N-3917. Checklist: create key, verify allowlist, validate demo run, revoke after demo.

maria_sales: Thanks team. Please set auto-revoke 1 hour after demo end and confirm log retention settings. Also include guidance for client to test key on their side before demo window.

kai_platform: Will set revoke_at = demo_end + 3600s and note anonymized logs retention = 30d. ETA: 90m to finish provisioning and post link.

maria_sales: Great — looping in customer for final CIDRs and demo time. :rocket:
